## EVIDENCE REPORT — Render Deployment Fix for Commit 91fce53

**ROOT ERROR:**
TypeScript syntax error — the GitHub version of `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` (commit `91fce53`) had a **missing closing brace** (409 open `{` vs 408 close `}`). The `for (branch of branchesToCheck)` loop's closing `}` was silently dropped during `github_commit_multi_file` gzip-base64 encoding. When `tsx` parsed the module on Render's Node 22 runtime at startup, it threw a syntax error at `node:internal/modules/run_main:123`, causing the process to exit with status 1 within ~44 seconds. The Docker build succeeded (it only copies files); the crash occurred at runtime when `node /app/node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs /app/server.ts` tried to import the broken module.

**AFFECTED FILE:**
`backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` — line 1073 (missing `}` to close the `for (branch of branchesToCheck)` loop at line 992)

**AFFECTED LINE:**
1073 — GitHub had `  }` (wrong indent, missing closing brace for the for-loop); correct version has `    }` followed by `    if (recovered) {` and `  } // end for (branch of branchesToCheck)`

**START COMMAND:**
`node /app/node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs /app/server.ts` (from `render.yaml` dockerCommand)

**MISSING/INVALID CONFIG:**
None — all Render environment variables were present and valid. The failure was purely a code syntax error from a corrupted GitHub commit. No missing module/import, no ESM/CommonJS incompatibility, no missing compiled output, no Supabase init failure, no DB connection failure, no port binding failure.

**FIX APPLIED:**
Re-committed the correct local file (409/409 balanced braces) via `github_commit_multi_file` API with gzip-base64 encoding. The local file was already correct; only the GitHub copy was corrupted. Verified the new GitHub file has balanced braces (409/409), contains `branchesToCheck`, `end for (branch`, and the V6.13 fix logic.
